faqs.q: What is the bailey smith salary?
faqs.a: The bailey smith salary is a term used to refer to the annual equivalent of a given hourly rate, typically under the National Minimum Wage or a modern award. For example, at the National Minimum Wage of $26.44 per hour for 38 hours per week, the annual salary is $52,254.8.

faqs.q: How do I calculate my annual salary from my hourly rate?
faqs.a: Multiply your hourly rate by your weekly hours (usually 38 for full-time) and then by 52 weeks. The formula is: annual gross = hourly rate × hours per week × 52. This assumes the same rate every week with no unpaid overtime or penalty rates.

faqs.q: Does the bailey smith salary include super and casual loading?
faqs.a: No. The bailey smith salary is the base annual gross before additions. Superannuation is paid on top at 12% of ordinary earnings. Casual loading is an extra 25% on the base hourly rate for casual employees, which increases the annual equivalent.

bodyMarkdown:
## Understanding the Bailey Smith Salary: Hourly to Annual Conversion

### What Is the Bailey Smith Salary?

The term "bailey smith salary" is often used to describe the annual pay that results from a given hourly rate, especially when comparing job offers or checking award minimums. Whether you are a full-time employee, a casual worker, or covered by a modern award, converting your hourly rate to an annual figure helps you budget, compare roles, and understand your total remuneration including super and tax.

### The Core Formula: Hourly to Annual

The standard conversion is straightforward:

**Annual gross = hourly rate × hours per week × 52 weeks**

For most full-time employees, the assumed week is 38 ordinary hours. If your hours differ, adjust accordingly. For example, the National Minimum Wage from 1 July 2026 is $26.44 per hour for a 38-hour week, giving a weekly amount of $1,004.90. Multiplying by 52 gives an annual gross of $52,254.80. This is the base bailey smith salary for an award/agreement-free adult employee.

### The Fortnightly View

Many Australians are paid fortnightly. To find your fortnightly gross, simply double the weekly figure. For the National Minimum Wage, that is $2,009.80 per fortnight. This can be useful when comparing with salary offers that quote a fortnightly or monthly amount.

### National Minimum Wage vs Award Rates

The National Minimum Wage applies only to employees not covered by an award or registered agreement. Most workers are covered by a modern award, which sets higher minimum rates for specific industries and occupations. The Fair Work Commission publishes the Modern Awards Pay Database, and the Fair Work Ombudsman provides pay guides for each award. Always check the relevant award before assuming the National Minimum Wage applies. The bailey smith salary for an award-covered employee may be significantly higher.

### Casual Loading

Casual employees receive a 25% loading on top of the base hourly rate. For the National Minimum Wage, the casual rate is $33.05 per hour ($26.44 × 1.25). The annual bailey smith salary for a casual working 38 hours per week would be $65,306.80 before super. Remember, the loading compensates for the lack of paid leave entitlements.

### Superannuation Paid on Top

Superannuation guarantee is 12% of ordinary earnings, paid by the employer on top of your salary. It does not come out of your gross pay. For the National Minimum Wage annual gross of $52,254.80, the employer would contribute an additional $6,270.58 in super, up to the maximum contribution base of $270,830. When considering a bailey smith salary, remember that super is extra and not part of your take-home pay.

### Tax and Take-Home Pay

Your annual gross is not what you take home. The 2026–27 resident tax rates apply: tax-free threshold up to $18,200, then 15% on income from $18,201 to $45,000, 30% from $45,001 to $135,000, 37% from $135,001 to $190,000, and 45% above $190,000. The Medicare levy is generally 2% of taxable income. For the National Minimum Wage bailey smith salary of $52,254.80, the estimated tax is $5,108.22 and Medicare is $1,045.10, leaving a net annual income of approximately $46,101.48. Use our [take-home pay](/topics/take-home) tool for a more personalised estimate.

### Using the Timesheet and Pay Guides

Our [the timesheet](/) allows you to enter your base hourly rate and optionally add the 25% casual loading. It then calculates your weekly, fortnightly, monthly, and annual gross figures. For award-specific rates, refer to the [pay guides](/blog) from the Fair Work Ombudsman. These guides list minimum rates, allowances, and penalty rates for each modern award.

### Example: Bailey Smith Salary Calculation

Let's say Bailey Smith is a full-time adult employee under the National Minimum Wage. The hourly rate is $26.44, weekly is $1,004.90, fortnightly is $2,009.80, and annual gross is $52,254.80. Super is $6,270.58 on top. After estimated tax and Medicare, the net annual is about $46,101.48. If Bailey were casual, the hourly rate would be $33.05, giving an annual gross of $65,306.80 and super of $7,836.82.

### Important Considerations

- The formula assumes 38 hours per week, 52 weeks per year, with no unpaid overtime, penalty rates, or allowances.
- Award rates may be higher than the National Minimum Wage. Always check your specific award.
- Casual loading is 25% on top of the base rate. Do not enter a rate that already includes loading into the timesheet; use the checkbox instead.
- Super is paid on top of ordinary earnings, not deducted from your salary.
- Tax estimates use the 2026–27 resident scale with the full tax-free threshold and 2% Medicare levy. HELP repayments, Medicare levy surcharge, and salary packaging are not included.

### Further Reading

For more details on minimum wages, see our [minimum wage](/topics/minimum-wage) page. To understand how super and packaging affect your total remuneration, visit [super and packaging](/topics/super-and-packaging). The [average pay](/topics/average-pay) page compares your bailey smith salary with national averages from the Australian Bureau of Statistics.

### Summary

The bailey smith salary is a handy way to think about annual pay from an hourly rate. By using the simple formula and understanding the components—base rate, casual loading, super, and tax—you can make informed decisions about job offers and career moves. Always refer to official sources like the Fair Work Commission and Fair Work Ombudsman for the most accurate and up-to-date rates.
